title: Runtimes
description: What a runtime is, shared by its config file, run/start, the run's start and the client: a service a runner talks to, named once in config. Definitions only.

name.title: Runtime name
name.description: A runtime's name: lowercase letters, digits and -, starting with a letter, at most 64. TROUPE_RUNTIME_<NAME>_... variables use it in capitals, with - as _.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: An http or https URL with a host, an optional port and an optional path, and no user info, query, fragment, whitespace or control character.

model.title: Model
model.description: A model's name, as the service names it: not empty, with no control character.

variable.title: Environment variable name
variable.description: Letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit, and not starting with TROUPE_ in any case.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where a resolved value came from: default (troupe's built-in runtimes), theatre (the theatre's config), env (the person's environment, TROUPE_RUNTIME_<NAME>_...), or actor (the actor's model).

price.title: Price
price.description: What a model costs at a service, in US dollars per million tokens of each kind, named after the result's usage counters. A rate a price doesn't give is unknown, not zero: an estimate needs a rate for every kind of token the run used.

input.description: US dollars per million input tokens, cache reads and writes excluded.

output.description: US dollars per million output tokens.

cacheRead.description: US dollars per million input tokens read from the service's prompt cache.

cacheWrite.description: US dollars per million input tokens written to the service's prompt cache.

resolved.title: Resolved runtime
resolved.description: A runtime as troupe resolved it from its defaults, the theatre's config and the person's environment, each value with its source. Never the credential's value.

endpoint.description: The endpoint, and where it came from. Absent: an in-process runtime, whose runner loads its model in its own process and talks to no service.

model.description: The model, and where it came from. Absent: nothing sets one, so a run on it is refused.

credential.description: The credential's variable, and where its name came from. Absent: the runtime has no credential.

env.description: Where the credential is read from: the variable's name, when config or a built-in runtime named it, or, when the person's environment named it, the TROUPE_RUNTIME_ variable that did, since a key put there by mistake passes for a name.

namedBy.description: The TROUPE_RUNTIME_<NAME>_CREDENTIAL_ENV variable that holds the name, which is never shown.

set.description: Whether the variable is set, and not empty, in the person's environment. Its value is never shown.

price.description: The price of the resolved model, and where it came from. Absent: nothing prices that model, or nothing sets a model.
